en: Black‑and‑white vintage photograph of a large European town square with a central monument, trees, and people walking across an open, unpaved plaza. Surrounding the square are historic multi‑story buildings with Baroque and Renaissance façades. Dominating the right side is a tall clock‑tower attached to a church; next to it stands another church with a bulbous Baroque dome. In the middle background is an ornate town hall-like building with gables and a small central tower. Shopfronts line the ground floors of the buildings around the square.
